remarks:
This hunting parcel (lot 1) is a corner lot consisting of 5.4 acres located near English Hill State Forest in Granger NY, Allegany County.

If you're looking for an affordable hunting property with excellent habitat and exceptional access, Lot 1 checks all the right boxes. Positioned at the corner of Weaver Settlement Road and Flat Iron Road in the Town of Granger, this wooded parcel offers exceptional road frontage, easy access, and the kind of habitat serious outdoorsmen look for. With approximately 976 feet of frontage on Weaver Settlement Road and 642 feet on Flat Iron Road, the corner configuration provides multiple access points making it easier to reach different stand locations without disturbing wildlife. The interior features a healthy mix of hardwoods, softwoods, and mature pines creating natural cover, browse, and travel corridors for deer and other game. Existing trails and a tree stand show the property has already been set up with hunting in mind. The level terrain and extensive road frontage also provide flexibility for future plans, whether you're envisioning a seasonal cabin, a campsite, or simply a private basecamp for outdoor adventures.

Owner financing available with 10% down and terms of up to 10 years at 10% APR. All rights convey.

The surrounding area is known for its abundant wildlife, and the property sits just minutes from English Hill State Forest giving you immediate access to thousands of additional acres for hunting, hiking, and year-round recreation.

Whether your goal is filling tags in the fall, escaping into the woods on weekends, or owning a well-located recreational property with outstanding access, this Granger parcel checks the boxes that matter.
